defects.defect: The fixed bottom navigation obscures the odds-table body, leaving the table visually clipped immediately below its header.

defects.region: bottom odds table behind fixed navigation

defects.defect: The Summon button is overlaid on top of the framed portal scene artwork and overlaps the scene's stone-platform area rather than sitting in its own panel row; its left/right edges (x≈85 and x≈640) also crowd the panel's ornate gold frame with unequal breathing room versus the frame inner edge

defects.defect: The 'Pull odds / Now / Next' header is only ~70px tall before it is cut by the bottom nav bar; nothing of the odds rows is visible and the header sits flush against the nav, reading as clipped rather than as an intentional continuation below the fold
defects.direction: Add bottom scroll padding so at least one odds row is visible above the nav bar, and keep nav-height inset spacing under the last panel

defects.defect: The '46s' timer is set much smaller than the '9/10' value and sits baseline-misaligned inside the chip, creating a ragged two-size mix within one pill

defects.defect: The tier badge is vertically centered on the title's optical center but its cap-height baseline sits slightly below the title baseline, and the badge's right edge (x≈695) does not align with the panel edge (x≈700)
